brief: A sealed dry box for spare resin bottles: covers top and bottom held with magnets, no open faces.

requirements.evidence: 2-high single cell (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full) with cover:0,0,0;full;bottom and cover:0,0,1;full;top plus 9 caps; check_build ok, meshClash clear, no OPEN_CAP_FACE. Enclosed shape helps but configurator checks fit only and parts are user-chosen 3D-print plastic, so airtight/waterproof dry storage is not verified.

finish.summary: Built a 2-storey single-cell sealed box with bottom and top covers (magnets fitted by default) and all open faces capped; check_build clear. Dry/airtight sealing not verifiable in the configurator.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall

events.text: Sealed magnetic box for resin — mapping the build.

connector.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

jointBolt.note: A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

result.note: Each family shows its first 6 offers; offers are valid until the next change.
Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

events.text: I've got the outline — now constructing a closed, magnet-fastened box.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.

events.text: The main shell is closed — now sealing the last faces and adding the magnetic hold.
